name: EcoDepot
tagline: A smart bin that recognises what you throw in, rotates to the right compartment and rewards students for recycling.
problem: People are unsure which bin an item belongs in and have little reason to care.
solution: Computer vision classifies the item on the chute and the bin rotates to the matching compartment; scanning a student ID logs the user in to an account with rewards.
demo_moment: Team-described: drop a can and watch the bin sort it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Surge Choice Award” and “SEE Sustainable Engineering Track” among 217 submissions.
Adds an incentive for people who are not eco-minded.

lessons: A moving physical object makes a sorting model visible.
